name: What is the difference between a powder room and a half bath?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a powder room and a half bath?

acceptedAnswer.text: The terms 'powder room' and 'half bath' are often used interchangeably to describe a bathroom containing only a toilet and a sink, without a shower or bathtub. Its primary purpose is to serve as a convenient facility for guests without needing to access a full bathroom. AKN Design Group specializes in transforming these compact spaces, ensuring that even a half bath contributes significantly to your home's design integrity and guest comfort. We focus on enhancing functionality, beauty, and value in every renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A powder room, also known as a half bath, is a compact bathroom with only a toilet and sink, designed primarily for guest use.
